desc: 暖赭金纸感场域与色带系统，密封袋与刀裁贴片双形态的十屏分镜
leaf: 独立密封袋装片状面膜
name: 暖赭金色带刀裁面膜款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼交代袋装加刀裁贴片的双重形态，用暖赭纸感场域抢点击。
用引用式标题栏加四枚留空圆片放大用户自身困扰，把问题说成可勾选清单。
shots.textZone: 顶部引用栏「{selling_point_1}」，四枚圆片下方各一行「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 以三联等分面板交代形态递进关系，让买家在同一光比下自行读出差别。
shots.textZone: 顶部一行「{selling_point_2}」，三联面板下方各一行「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」

shots.intent: 用一处微距证明工艺与贴合轮廓的可信度，替代任何无法核实的材质说法。
把原料说明做成可替换的双栏卡片，标题与胶囊位一律留空由后期填真值。
shots.textZone: 两栏标题位「{selling_point_3}」，胶囊标签位「{callout_8}」「{callout_9}」，其余为空白细线

shots.intent: 把产品放进晚间护理台面，让买家对号入座，同时回避任何可辨识面容。
用一张全空的参数卡消解规格疑虑，数值与品名一律等真值后期填入。
shots.textZone: 右侧参数卡五行留空，仅卡头一枚圆角标签占位「{selling_point_4}」

shots.intent: 用两乘二同款展示墙让买家横向比较可选形态，光比与裁切严格一致。
用一圈空心证章位承接背书信息，全部留空等真资质，绝不生成检测报告。
shots.textZone: 中心圆盘一行「{selling_point_5}」，环上八枚标签全为空白细线

shots.intent: 用一条深色带与一枚空白按钮位收口，把促销口径留给真实活动文案。
shots.textZone: 底部深咖色带中央一枚空白圆角按钮位，按钮文案仅占位「{callout_2}」

style.backgroundSystem: flat oat-ivory #FBF5E7 and straw-paper #F2E5C6 fields with hairline dotted rules, alternating with solid kiln-ochre #C08A2E colour-block bands; no gradients, no marble, no tiles
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, quarter-rounded single-corner swatch plates, one dashed vertical divider, empty double-line stamp outlines carrying no artwork
style.lightingSystem: soft directional key from the upper left with warm bounce fill on the shadow side, short grounded contact shadows, no hard speculars; the one evening scene keeps a 3200K lamp source at the left
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm gold-ochre skincare detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of oat ivory #FBF5E7, kiln ochre #C08A2E, brick rust #A2502F and deep coffee ink #40291B over a straw-paper secondary field #F2E5C6; warm tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif as the single type family with headline rails set inside a hairline rounded quote frame; background system of flat paper-ivory fields with hairline dotted rules alternating with solid kiln-ochre colour-block bands; matte sand-clay counter #E9DFC8 with a fine mineral grain as the only surface; soft directional key light from the upper left with warm bounce fill and short grounded contact shadows; thin single-weight line icons with quarter-rounded swatch plates, one dashed vertical divider and empty double-line stamp outlines; all in-image wording supplied only as placeholders; stable product scale and upright placement; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no gradients, marble, mirror or tile surfaces, no water splash, ripple or droplet motifs, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented seals, badges or numbers.
noDrift: no colour palette changes beyond #FBF5E7, #F2E5C6, #C08A2E, #A2502F and #40291B
no gradients, marble, mirror plates or tiled walls
no water splash, ripple, droplet or mist motifs
no mixed fonts, no script or serif-italic lettering
no invented seals, certificates, badges, numbers or efficacy wording
style.presentationRules: the sealed pouch stands upright with one unfolded die-cut sheet leaning at its base as a pair; identical crop, scale and light inside any multi-cell grid; product never clipped and never above 70% of a frame
style.surfaceSystem: matte sand-clay counter #E9DFC8 with a fine mineral grain as the only tabletop, no mirror plate, no polished stone
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif as the single family, headline rails set inside a hairline rounded quote frame in deep coffee ink #40291B; no script, no serif italics, no rendered copy beyond placeholder slots
